correctness.rationale: With r occupied rim sites, Q=r+t² and exchange B in units of J, expansion gives B+r=Σ(s_i+s_(i+1))(s_i+s_(i+1)+t)/2; every summand is nonnegative. For even n a full alternating rim attains −n for any hub spin, exhausts equality at r=n and supplies both occupied lines. At δ=1 only t=0 can tie zero, with every rim edge enforcing s_(i+1)=−s_i, hence the two alternating rims and the zero assignment. For odd n and t=0, every nonempty occupied path pays at least 1 from its two vacancy boundaries; a full odd rim costs at least 2 above −n. For t≠0 and one rim vacancy, all local costs cannot vanish because an even alternating occupied path cannot have both ends −t; integer costs then give B≥−(n−2). A full odd rim likewise costs at least 1 above −n. Together with B≥−r for t≠0, these give the stated sector lower bounds. For δ<1 lower nonzero occupancies cannot tie Q=n−1, and Q=n is strictly beaten by Q=n−1 for δ>0 or by full occupation for δ≤0. For δ≥1 the odd nonempty sectors have positive energy. At full odd occupancy equality is one −t,−t defect, giving 2n assignments. At Q=n−1 there are 2n zero-hub alternating-path choices; for t≠0, each occupied path would need odd length and endpoints −t, so the odd total n−2 excludes two separate paths. The two vacancies are adjacent, giving another 2n. The crossings of the attaining lines are at 1/2 and (n−2)/(n−1), and coalescence for n=3 yields counts 6+12+1. For even n the two crossings give 4+2 and 2+1, respectively. These equality and comparison arguments apply for every stated real δ, independent of finite replay.
residual_risks: Positive intermediate width is for odd n≥5, with n=3 expressly exceptional. No nonzero-field or finite-temperature claim; frozen scripts were inspected, not newly executed.

value.rationale: Wheel triangles couple a global hub choice to the parity obstruction of a rim. The exact all-size classification distinguishes a single hub vacancy on even rims from two structurally different ways to accommodate two vacancies on odd rims and pins down crossings and exceptional K4 coexistence. The surviving quantitative result is useful as a finite frustrated-cluster benchmark, independently of the already covered nonvacant Ising sector.
